exact.Plánovač agility parkurů: 90 parkurů pod: Agility course planner: 90 courses following FCI rules and judges' style (curves, crossings, curved tunnels), trainers' courses, rule check, SCT and MCT calculation, stopwatch with grading and split times, wraps around the wing and jump backsides, 3D flythrough, memory training, technique videos, training log and statistics.
exact.Novinky v 1.9: aplikace k instalaci do t: New in 1.9: an app to install on your phone (Chrome → Install app). Photo and video picking, saving images, PDFs and backups work there, a course map can be sent via Share from the gallery straight to the reader, plus the course catalogue and cloud backup. It updates itself.
exact.Novinky v 1.8: Plánek z obrázku přečte i: New in 1.8: Course map from photo also reads the route. It recognises the order from the numbers in circles, and from the drawn line the jump directions, tunnel and contact entries, wraps around the wing and backsides. It finds a missing tyre, long jump, double bar, wall or dog walk by its number. Uncertain places are marked with a question mark. In the Android app you can also paste the map from the clipboard.
exact.Novinky v 1.7: tlačítko Zkontrolovat nov: New in 1.7: a Check for new courses button in Courses, new courses carry a New label and a dot on the tab, plus the trainer's course Euskadi Sextuple 2018 A1.
exact.Novinky v 1.6: nový generátor parkurů, n: New in 1.6: a new course generator, course difficulty and sorting, course analysis with handler guidance, time estimate and the Can I make it? simulation, the path by dog size, classic exercises and a club course in the generator, live and video split times, smart training, reading the route aloud, course map from photo, building on the field with a compass and a Getting started section for puppies.
exact.Data se ukládají v tomhle zařízení. Sdíl: Data is stored on this device. Sharing by code and cloud backup run via the Supabase server and work in the installed app. Saving PDFs and images to the phone and the photo underlay work in the web version.
